name.description: Name of the command for reference.

items.description: SQLCommand is one statement run at startup, before any table is created.

commands.description:
SQL commands run once at startup, before the server listens. Attach the
backend here, READ_ONLY.

name.description: Names this server in its logs.

addr.description: host:port to listen on. Defaults to 0.0.0.0:8080.

allowed_origins.description:
Exact origins, such as https://turbolytics.io: a scheme, a host and an
optional port. No path and no wildcard.

cors.description: Browser origins allowed to call. Omit to send no CORS headers.

http.description: Where to listen, and which browser origins may call.

name.description: Names the client in the request log.

token.description:
The value a client sends as Authorization: Bearer <token>. It is an
identifier, not a secret: a browser page ships it in plain sight.

max_rows.description:
Most rows one response carries. 0 means 10000. A cut result says
truncated: true.

timeout_seconds.description:
Longest a caller waits for a query, in seconds. 0 means 10. The query
itself runs to completion: DuckDB cannot be cancelled.

rate_limit.description:
Reserved. Parsed so a config written now keeps its shape; refused when
any field is non-zero.

limits.description: Limits for every dataset. A dataset's own non-zero limit overrides one.

name.description:
The URL path segment: /v1/datasets/<name>. Lowercase letters, digits
and underscores, starting with a letter.
The query parameter name, and the $name the SQL reads.

type.description:
How the value parses and binds: string as VARCHAR, integer as BIGINT,
timestamp (RFC 3339 with an offset) as TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE.

params.description:
Query parameters the SQL reads as $name. Every statement must use every
param. An absent param binds NULL; default it in SQL with coalesce.

max_rows.description:
Most rows one response carries. 0 means 10000. A cut result says
truncated: true.

timeout_seconds.description:
Longest a caller waits for a query, in seconds. 0 means 10. The query
itself runs to completion: DuckDB cannot be cancelled.

rate_limit.description:
Reserved. Parsed so a config written now keeps its shape; refused when
any field is non-zero.

limits.description: Overrides the top-level limits for this dataset.

sql.description: The statement, for a dataset without grains. Set sql or grains.

grains.description: One statement per grain, selected by ?grain=<name>. Set sql or grains.

items.description: ServeDataset is one named, parameterized SQL statement, or one per grain.

datasets.description: The datasets this server answers. Nothing else is reachable.

serve.description: What to serve, to whom, and within which limits.

description: ServeConf is a whole serve file: the commands that attach the data, and the serve block that exposes it.
